_source: Roofing line: CAT-26 Roof Sheeting, CAT-27 Flashings, Ridges & Fixings and CAT-28 Insulation, Underlay & Rainwater (ROOFING_CATALOGUE.md). Sheets come in standard lengths of 3.0, 3.6, 4.2, 4.8, 6.0 and 6.6 m (one unit each) and are cut to any length from 1 m to 14 m on a quote (unit METRE, always quoted: the cutting list travels with the quote). A sheet is live only where at least two SA retailers show a regular price for the same profile, thickness and coating: the benchmark is the lowest price per metre, a standard length is that rate x the length, and list = benchmark x 1.08. Everything else is quoted with the supplier. Concrete roof tiles are in the masonry line (CAT-29). Roof & structural timber (CAT-30) is SA pine in S5 or S7, H2 or H3, sized or rough-sawn, in lengths of 3.0 to 6.6 m (one unit each); connectors and accessories are CAT-31. Timber is priced on the same rule as sheets: at least two SA retailers' regular prices for the same section, grade, hazard class and length, list = benchmark x 1.08; otherwise quoted.
